items.title: FDA clears AI tool that creates 3D bone visualizations from standard MRIs
items.excerpt: MRI2CT won FDA clearance for AI that turns standard MRIs into CT-like 3D bone models, aiming for 'MRI-only workflows in spine care' that spare patients the extra radiation of a CT.
items.rationale: A new FDA clearance with a direct patient benefit: spine patients could skip a CT scan and its radiation.

items.title: Suki launches 'Ask' feature for clinical decision support driven by Wolters Kluwer UpToDate AI API
items.excerpt: Ambient-documentation vendor Suki launched 'Ask', letting clinicians pose complex clinical questions inside its assistant and get answers grounded in Wolters Kluwer's UpToDate evidence via a new AI API.
items.rationale: A product clinicians already use now answers clinical questions from UpToDate evidence, at the point of care.

items.title: “AI가 내린 우울증 진단 믿지 마세요”…政, 과의존 경고
items.excerpt: 보건복지부와 대한신경정신의학회가 정신건강의 날을 앞두고 생성형 AI의 우울증 진단을 의학적 판단으로 받아들이지 말고 위기 상황에선 전문가 도움을 받으라고 당부했다.
items.rationale: Korea's health ministry and the psychiatric society issued an official public warning about patients relying on chatbot depression diagnoses.

items.title: Early epilepsy detection from electronic health records with large language models
items.excerpt: LLMs applied to EHR notes separate epilepsy from psychogenic non-epileptic seizures earlier; the two look alike but need very different management, and misdiagnosis is common.
items.rationale: LLMs read real patient records to tell epilepsy apart from a common look-alike earlier, which targets a frequent misdiagnosis.

items.title: An audit-ready EHR foundation model for order-time medication-safety auditing across health systems
items.excerpt: ClinicalGPT, an EHR foundation model, audits medication orders for safety at order time across health systems, flagging when stale or missing lab and medication evidence undermines the check.
items.rationale: A patient-safety model that checks medication orders when they are placed, validated across several health systems.
